summary: goto_level() leaves the old level’s travel destination cached. C clears iflags.travelcc after reset_trapset(); JavaScript skips that assignment under an obsolete unported-travel comment. After descending, the next travel prompt starts at the old destination instead of the hero. The mismatch is deterministic state left behind by level departure.

source.branch: A successful level change passes the same-level and quest guards while iflags.travelcc holds a destination selected on the departing level. Clear both cached coordinates during context discard, after reset_trapset() and before clearing the polearm target. Rejected or same-level transitions return before that reset.
callers: js/cmd.js:3361 and 5643 dispatch the > command through dodown(); js/do.js:1174 calls next_level(!trap, state, { gotoLevel: goto_level }). This matches do.c dodown():1288-1291.
js/dungeon.js:764-787 next_level() invokes the injected goto_level() with the staircase destination, matching dungeon.c next_level():1497-1514. The observed step 599 descends through this path.

js/cmd.js:2596-2626 dotravel() reads iflags.travelcc; cmd.c dotravel():5314-5341 uses the hero position only when both cached coordinates are zero. js/getpos.js:529-550 positions the prompt cursor at those coordinates.
dependencies: iflags.travelcc is the existing travel destination cache shared by cmd.c dotravel()/dotravel_target(), hack.c findtravelpath(), and level departure. Retain that single state location; u.tx/u.ty are distinct C fields and are not reset by do.c:1607.
Existing maybe_reset_pick(), reset_trapset(), and context.polearm.hitmon establish the source ordering. This correction needs no additional callee or random draw.
